Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.args

Class ArgSet

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.args.ArgSet
All Implemented Interfaces:
Argument
public class ArgSet extends Object implements Argument
A special type of string argument that can take a set of predefined string values. Useful for commands that have options or modes.

ArgSets typically are in the form of [value1|value2|value3] in string form, however that form may also be used to define subcommands who take in the exact same amount and type of parameters.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
